mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops falling and rises from its current trough while TRANSIT remains roughly stable, weekday trips to shopping areas should recover and push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks. The mechanism fails if commuting stays depressed or declines further.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -13.7 to -32.7 while RETAIL_REC moved from -24.9 to -26.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean even as WORKPLACES turns upward and TRANSIT does not deteriorate further.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL time after work-from-home intensifies local substitution toward neighborhood errands, which lifts retail-and-recreation visits within one to two weeks. If the residential increase is not accompanied by reduced commuting time, the effect should not appear.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 18 points while WORKPLACES stays below -25 points
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased from 13.7 to 18.1 while WORKPLACES fell to -32.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks after RESIDENTIAL crosses the threshold and WORKPLACES remains deeply negative.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in TRANSIT above its recent low is a leading indicator of broader reopening of discretionary trips, so retail-and-recreation mobility should rise over the next four weeks. The signal fails if transit rebounds only because of essential travel while retail stays weak.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points from a local low
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -37.3 to -36.0 after a multiweek decline
failure_condition: TRANSIT rebounds by at least 5 points from its trough but RETAIL_REC still averages lower over the next 28 days than over the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rapidly recover from deep negatives, outdoor activity substitutes for indoor shopping and delays discretionary retail trips, so RETAIL_REC should be lower over the next one to two weeks. If park use rebounds without displacing indoor leisure, the effect should disappear.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises from below -20 to above -10 within one week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from -28.4 to -5.9 in the latest week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall or remain below its recent mean within one week after PARKS crosses the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained weakness in WORKPLACES combined with weak TRANSIT suppresses discretionary shopping trips by reducing commuting-linked spillovers, so retail-and-recreation mobility should stay below the prior four-week average over the next four weeks. The effect fails if commuting partially normalizes.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined to -32.7 and TRANSIT stayed near -36.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at or below their current depressed levels.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM turns positive, households are shifting back to in-person essential errands, which typically precedes a broader rebound in discretionary retail visits within two weeks. If the gain is only stock-up behavior, retail will not follow.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses above 0 and stays positive for two weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -6.4 to 0.4 in the latest week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM remains above zero for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous break in PARKS and TRANSIT toward higher values indicates eased movement constraints, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks more than either series alone. The signal fails if only one mobility channel recovers.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -10 and TRANSIT rises above -30 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved sharply while TRANSIT remained very weak
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior four-week mean after both PARKS and TRANSIT clear their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a holiday or weather-driven demand shock, rising RESIDENTIAL time together with stable-to-higher GROCERY_PHARM signals more local, non-retail activity and diverts spending from shopping centers, so RETAIL_REC should remain lower over the next four weeks. If household time at home falls or grocery trips weaken, the effect should not hold.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 13.7 to 18.1 while GROCERY_PHARM reached 0.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean despite RESIDENTIAL staying elevated and GROCERY_PHARM not weakening.
